title: Swap site logo to new uploaded image

requirements.summary: Add the uploaded logo as optimized static assets in 128x128 and 512x512 sizes under frontend/public/assets/generated.
acceptanceCriteria: Two new logo files exist in frontend/public/assets/generated with the specified filenames and dimensions.
The generated logo images look visually consistent with the uploaded image (same mark and text), with clean edges and no unexpected cropping.
The 128x128 version remains legible at small sizes (header use).

file_operations.description: Create an optimized 128x128 PNG logo derived from the user-provided image, preserving transparency if present, saved at this exact path/filename for header-sized usage.
Create an optimized 512x512 PNG logo derived from the user-provided image, preserving transparency if present, saved at this exact path/filename for large/logo usage.

requirements.summary: Update centralized brand asset references so all logo usages (including the header) render the new logo without layout changes.
acceptanceCriteria: BRAND_ASSETS.logo.standard references the new 128x128 logo asset path.
BRAND_ASSETS.logo.large references the new 512x512 logo asset path.
The header logo displayed in frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx renders the new image without layout breakage (no overflow, no distortion, sizes unchanged).

file_operations.description: Update BRAND_ASSETS.logo.standard to '/assets/generated/terra-vedant-logo-new.dim_128x128.png' and BRAND_ASSETS.logo.large to '/assets/generated/terra-vedant-logo-new.dim_512x512.png' so existing logo consumers (e.g., SiteHeader) automatically show the new logo.
